methods.name: handler.register
methods.summary: Register a handler connection for event delivery.

bot_ids.description: Bot identities this handler wants to serve.

event_types.description: Event types the handler wants to receive.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the handler requests. Valid values are ReadMessages, SendMessages, ManageProfile, SendGroupMessages, ReceiveGroupMessages, CreateMlsGroup, InviteToMlsGroup, ExitMlsGroup, SendReactions, SendAttachments, SendGroupReactions, SendGroupAttachments, and Admin.

reconnect_token.description: Server-generated secret token for reconnecting this handler.

registered_events.description: Event types the handler is now subscribed to.

own_pubkeys.description: Map from daemon-local bot_id to the bot's Nostr public key (npub).

spool_dir.description: Absolute outbound spool directory where handlers may stage attachment payloads.

methods.name: handler.reconnect
methods.summary: Reconnect a previously registered handler using its secret reconnect token.

handler_id.description: Server-generated handler id from the original registration.

reconnect_token.description: Secret reconnect token returned by the original registration.

registered_events.description: Event types the handler is now subscribed to.

own_pubkeys.description: Map from daemon-local bot_id to the bot's Nostr public key (npub).

spool_dir.description: Absolute outbound spool directory where handlers may stage attachment payloads.

methods.name: handler.unregister
methods.summary: Remove a handler from the routing table.

unregistered.description: True when the connection's handler was removed.

methods.name: agent.send_dm
methods.summary: Send a direct message as the specified bot.

bot_id.description: Bot identity that will send the message.

recipient.description: Nostr public key (npub or hex) of the recipient.

reply_to.description: Optional hex event id this message replies to.

schema.description: Hex id of the published gift-wrap event.

methods.name: agent.send_reaction
methods.summary: React to a direct-message rumor as the specified bot.

bot_id.description: Bot identity that will send the reaction.

recipient.description: Nostr public key (npub or hex) of the recipient.

target_rumor_id.description: Hex id of the rumor being reacted to.

schema.description: Hex id of the published gift-wrap event.

methods.name: agent.send_attachment
methods.summary: Encrypt, upload, and send a direct-message attachment as the specified bot.

bot_id.description: Bot identity that will send the attachment.

recipient.description: Nostr public key (npub or hex) of the recipient.

spool_path.description: Path confined to the outbound attachment spool.

inline_base64.description: Standard-base64 payload below the inline threshold.

dim.description: Optional image dimensions in WIDTHxHEIGHT form.

reply_to.description: Optional hex rumor id this attachment replies to.

schema.description: Hex id of the published gift-wrap event.

methods.name: agent.set_profile
methods.summary: Update the bot's Nostr kind:0 profile.

bot_id.description: Bot identity whose profile will be updated.

schema.description: Hex id of the published kind:0 metadata event.

methods.name: agent.error
methods.summary: Report an error encountered by a handler.

bot_id.description: Bot identity the error relates to.

methods.name: handler.response
methods.summary: Handler reply to a delivered agent.event.

event_id.description: Hex event id the handler is responding to.

action.description: Terminal action the daemon should take.

methods.name: agent.event
methods.summary: Notification of an incoming event for a registered bot. For squad messages, the daemon forwards the parsed mention envelope and computed mention metadata (is_mentioned, mentioned_bot_ids, mentions) alongside the message content.

bot_id.description: Bot identity the event is for.

event_id.description: Hex id of the enclosing gift-wrap event.

chat_id.description: Conversation identifier; the sender's npub for DMs or the Squad wire id for MLS welcome and group messages.

mentions.description: Target npubs from the mention envelope; empty for DMs and legacy squad messages.

is_mentioned.description: Whether the receiving bot's npub appears in `mentions`.

mentioned_bot_ids.description: Configured `bot_id` values whose npubs appear in `mentions`.

pacto_virtual_bucket.description: Virtual bucket identifier from the mention envelope; omitted for DMs and legacy squad messages.

rumor_id.description: Hex id of the decrypted rumor.

author.description: Public key of the original message author.

reaction.description: Present only when type is reaction_received; the reacted-to rumor and the emoji.

target_rumor_id.description: Hex id of the rumor the reaction targets.

attachment.description: Present only when type is attachment_received; a verified plaintext file in the inbound spool.

mime_type.description: Mime type from the file-type rumor tag.

size.description: Plaintext byte count, equal to the file size at path.

filename.description: Optional untouched sender filename; never used for the spool path.

path.description: Absolute path to the verified plaintext spool file.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp after which the spool file may be removed.

bot_unavailable.description: Present only when type is bot_unavailable; which condition left the bot unusable for group operations (U11/R37).

reason.description: state_lost: a group's engine state was lost to a store reset and awaits re-invitation. engine_unavailable: the bot's MLS engine failed to construct after a fail-closed store classification (R49).

methods.name: agent.rate_limited
methods.summary: Notification that an inbound MLS group message was dropped because the per-Squad rate limit was exceeded.

bot_id.description: Bot identity the Squad belongs to.

window_seconds.description: Duration of the rate-limit window in seconds.

methods.name: agent.is_squad_member
methods.summary: Verify whether a Nostr public key is a member of a Squad.

bot_id.description: Bot identity that participates in the Squad.

member_pubkey.description: Nostr public key (npub or hex) of the member to check.

is_member.description: True when the public key is a member of the Squad.

methods.name: agent.exit_mls_group
methods.summary: Exit a Squad by publishing a self-removal MLS proposal.

bot_id.description: Bot identity that participates in the Squad.

event_id.description: Hex id of the published kind:445 evolution event containing the leave proposal.

methods.name: agent.delete_mls_group
methods.summary: Remove this bot's local MLS state for a Squad. Local-only: other members are not notified.

bot_id.description: Bot identity whose local Squad state is removed.

deleted.description: True when local state was removed, false when the group was already absent.

methods.name: agent.status
methods.summary: Daemon lifecycle status notification. Carries the daemon-wide version and MLS wire generation only -- never a per-bot or per-group map. Per-bot reset state, per-group state-held/state-lost, and sole-admin squad detail are reported by `pacto-bot-admin diagnose` instead, since this notification fans out to every registered handler regardless of which bots it registered for.

identity.description: Public key of the bot whose state changed, when applicable.

daemon_version.description: Daemon crate version. Daemon-wide only -- no per-bot detail is carried on this notification.

mls_wire_generation.description: Identifier for the MLS wire encoding generation this daemon speaks (e.g. base64 KeyPackage/Welcome content with a mandatory `encoding` tag).

methods.name: agent.metrics
methods.summary: Return a machine-readable health and metrics snapshot.

methods.name: agent.list_handlers
methods.summary: Return the daemon's handler routing table (admin-only).

methods.name: agent.unregister_handler
methods.summary: Forcibly remove a handler from the routing table. The caller must be the target handler itself or have the Admin capability.

methods.name: agent.version
methods.summary: Return the daemon version and git commit hash.

methods.summary: Return the daemon version and git commit hash.

methods.name: system.health
methods.summary: Return a machine-readable health and metrics snapshot.

recipient.description: Nostr public key (npub or hex) of the recipient.

methods.name: admin.create_mls_group
methods.summary: Create a new MLS group and invite the recipient (admin-only).

bot_id.description: Bot identity that will own the group.

recipient.description: Nostr public key (npub or hex) of the initial member. The daemon fetches this recipient's most recent KeyPackage event (kind:443 or kind:30443, both accepted) and rejects one missing the required `encoding` tag with a distinct peer-version-mismatch error (-32025) rather than a generic parse failure.

admins.description: Optional explicit admin set (npub or hex Nostr public keys), additive only. Defaults to the creator plus the invited recipient when omitted. MDK rejects a set omitting the creator.
